subject.title: feat(discord/voice): add sessionChannelId to autoJoin for text-channel transcript routing

question: Should Discord voice-to-text mirroring extend the existing `voice.agentSession` routing surface, or should OpenClaw add a separate per-autoJoin `sessionChannelId` config field?
rationale: Both designs can address the user problem, but the repository policy treats new config and delivery defaults as compatibility-sensitive, and current main already has a partial global `voice.agentSession` routing surface.

options.title: Extend `voice.agentSession` as canonical bridge
options.body: Use the existing target-session routing surface and add explicit, documented text mirroring semantics there before considering per-autoJoin aliases.

options.title: Add per-autoJoin `sessionChannelId`
options.body: Accept a new per-entry config field for fixed-room pairings, with same-guild validation, explicit delivery targeting, docs, and migration/upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep audio-only delivery
options.body: Leave current `voice.agentSession` as session routing only and close or defer automatic visible transcript/reply mirroring.

recommendation.title: Extend `voice.agentSession` as canonical bridge
recommendation.body: Use the existing target-session routing surface and add explicit, documented text mirroring semantics there before considering per-autoJoin aliases.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history across Discord voice routing, config/docs, and issue review for this exact product boundary.
